summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric services company, announcing the results of a bookbuilding procedure for a public offering of simple, non-convertible, unsecured debentures (11th issuance) totaling R$500 million. The offering is conducted under automatic registration with CVM Resolution 160, targeted at professional investors, and managed by BTG Pactual and XP Investimentos. The debentures have a final risk rating of brAAA from S&P. The filing is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation event.
